title: The Companies Act, 2017
sponsoringMinistry: Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Industry

sections.title: Short title and commencement
sections.content: This Act may be cited as the Companies Act, 2017, and shall come into operation on the date appointed by the Minister by statutory instrument.

sections.title: Types of companies
sections.content: A company may be incorporated under this Act as— (a) a private company limited by shares; (b) a public company; (c) a company limited by guarantee; or (d) an unlimited company.

sections.title: Application for incorporation
sections.content: An application for the incorporation of a company shall be made to the Registrar in the prescribed form and shall be accompanied by the prescribed fee.

sections.title: Number of directors
sections.content: A private company shall have at least two directors, and a public company shall have at least three directors. At least half of the directors of a company shall be resident in Zambia.

sections.title: Duties of directors
sections.content: A director of a company shall act in good faith, in the best interests of the company, and with the degree of care, diligence, and skill that a reasonably prudent person would exercise in comparable circumstances.
